report_identity.report_title: BII Railway Transportation Technology Holdings Company Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides hardware and software products and services for high-speed railways, intercity railways, suburban railways and metro systems, intelligent railway transportation, operation and maintenance, civil communication transmission systems, utility tunnel areas and integrated transportation hubs, and also makes railway transportation and infrastructure equity investments.

segments.business_substance: Major service line revenue from passenger information related railway products and services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 4(a), revenue disaggregation, report p.105

segments.business_substance: Major service line revenue from data and integration services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 4(a), revenue disaggregation, report p.105

segments.business_substance: Major service line revenue from intelligent infrastructure.
segments.source: Annual Report 2023, note 4(a), revenue disaggregation, report p.105

business_overview.revenue_model: Project/service contracts for railway and metro technology products, system integration, operation and maintenance services; revenue is recognised over time or when products are delivered according to IFRS 15 policies.
business_notes: Remaining performance obligations at 31 December 2023 were HK$2,533,401,000, expected to be recognised over the next 1 to 48 months.
The group's principal operating subsidiaries disclosed as material non-controlling interest subsidiaries are mainly PRC entities.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year parent net profit is stable, but operating cash flow is much weaker than profit because trade receivables and contract assets keep absorbing cash. Median 2021-2023 free cash flow after PPE/intangible purchases is negative, so owner distributable cash profit must be heavily discounted.

evidence.value: RMB is not freely convertible and remittance out of Mainland China is subject to PRC foreign exchange control rules
evidence.note: Supports haircut on group cash that is not split by holding company/subsidiaries.

gaps: The annual report does not split unrestricted cash between listed holding company, Hong Kong subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries and other entities.
The annual report does not disclose a precise maintenance versus growth capital expenditure split.
Restricted bank deposits are identified by amount but the detailed restriction purpose is not fully extracted beyond note 20(a)/note 33 cross-reference in this run.
